{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Count all unique patients (enrolled) regardless of QC status
# The question asks for total enrolled patients, so we must include all patient_id values
# even if they have biomarker_baseline == -999 or are re-tested
unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f'Total number of unique patients (enrolled): {unique_patients}')"}
